reason: BVH's five pointer/texture members differ by construction (each library allocates its own node arena), so those bytes are masked with ignore_offsets; the compared bytes are mNumNodes, mMaxNodes and mMaxDepth, which prove both builds emit the same node count and tree depth. Node *contents* are compared by an out-of-tree dlopen A/B harness (2000 random builds, byte-identical) because the generic driver cannot reach the callee-owned arena. The BVH argument is spelled BVH* rather than BVH& only because ignore_offsets is implemented for pointer arguments (identical ABI).
